title: Automating literature screening and knowledge synthesis with large language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific literature is expanding rapidly, yet much of its knowledge remains difficult to organize and reuse due to the substantial workload needed to navigate large, heterogeneous literature corpora. Here, we develop a generalizable large language model (LLM)-powered framework that automates literature screening, structured information extraction, and knowledge synthesis within a unified workflow. We benchmarked 11 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight LLMs across three materials science screening tasks differing in scope, corpus size, and class imbalance. Seven LLMs achieved balanced accuracies above 0.90 across all tasks, with the best-performing LLM reaching 0.96--0.98, demonstrating the potential of LLMs to accurately screen large, highly imbalanced scientific corpora. translated_title: 利用大语言模型实现文献筛选与知识综合的自动化
translated_abstract: 科学文献正在快速扩张，但由于浏览大型、异构文献语料库需要巨大的工作量，其中许多知识仍然难以组织和复用。在此，我们开发了一个可泛化的、由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的框架，可在统一的工作流程中实现文献筛选、结构化信息提取和知识综合的自动化。我们在三项范围、语料库规模和类别不平衡程度各不相同的材料科学筛选任务上，对11个最先进的专有和开源权重LLM进行了基准测试。七个LLM在所有任务中均实现了高于0.90的平衡准确率，其中表现最佳的LLM达到0.96–0.98，证明了LLM准确筛选大型、高度不平衡科学语料库的潜力。该框架还大幅减少了人工工作量，在四分钟内即可筛选10,000条记录，而人工筛选约需83个人工小时。
tldr: 该研究开发了一个由大语言模型驱动的统一自动化框架，可完成文献筛选、结构化信息提取与知识综合，在材料科学任务中平衡准确率超过0.90，并将筛选1万条记录的时间从约83个人工小时缩短至4分钟。
en_tdlr: This study develops a generalizable LLM-powered framework that automates literature screening, structured information extraction, and knowledge synthesis in a unified workflow, achieving balanced accuracies above 0.90 on materials science tasks while reducing the time to screen 10,000 records from about 83 person-hours to just four minutes.
